notes: New: Manual Cannon (buy it in Ship Repairs) - hold left mouse / push the right stick to fire a piercing lance wherever you aim
Spells rebuilt as full-screen shows + 4 new ones: Black Hole, Meteor Storm, Chain Storm, Orbital Laser
OVERDRIVE: kills fill a gold meter, press F to unleash ALL your spells in a cascade
Swarm packs: far bigger crowds to clear; massacre / annihilation bonuses for big spell kills
New spell and combat sounds, reverb, kill pitch rises with your streak
